generalCriterionList.description: Tenders  from Joint ventures are not acceptable.

Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for
 corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka
Bidders shall ensure upload of relevant document certifying his/her status as Scheduled Caste/ Scheduled Tribe/other reserved category as prescribed in the tender document.

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.

technicalCriterionList.description: Minimum financial turnover (civil engineering construction works) not less than two times the annual payments from this contract (Rs. xxxxx Lakhs)
Satisfactoriy completed (atleast 90%) as prime contractor at-least one such similar work of value not less than Rs. xxxxxxx (80% of estimated cost of tender)

Tenderer or his identified Sub Contractor should possess valid Electrical License for executing building electrificatio works and should have executed similar electrical works totallng Rs. xxxxxx (not less than 50% of electrical works) n any one year

Tenderer or his identified Sub Contractor should possess valid license for executing water supply / sanitary engineering works  and should have executed similar works totallng Rs. xxxxxx (not less than 50% of electrical works) n any one year
Total value of civl engineering works executed and payments received in the last five years (year-wise)
List of existing commitments and ongoing works
List of works for which tenders already submitted
Construction equipment owned by the tenderer and equipment proposed to be deployed on this contract, if awarded
Reports on the financial standing of the tenderer, such as profit and loss statements and auditor’s reports for the last five years
Qualification and experience of the key technical and management personnel in permanent employment with the tenderer and those that are proposed to be deployed on this contract, if awarded

Proposals for subcontracting components of works amounting to more than 20% of the contract price (for each, the qualifications and experience of the identified sub-contractor in the relevant fields should be attached)

Satisfactorily completed (at least 50% of the contract value) as prime contractor, One Similar nature of any Stall erection work/kiosk works etc., for Rs 11.89 lakhs in any one year in the last 5 financial years of 2021-22 to 2025-26.
Bidders must submit prototype model of Strawberry fruit, Burger and Popcorn kiosk unit to the office and get it certified from AEE, KEA and Shall Upload the same in Tender.
Turnover certificate form CA with UDIN Number with minimum Turnover for Rs. 47.56 lakhs in any one year in the last 5 financial years of 2021-22 to 2025-26.

tenderSubEstimateList.subEstimateName: Providing, fabricating, supplying, transporting, installing, testing, and commissioning Complete Strawberry fruit, Burger and Popcorn kiosk unit for Food Court Area inside KEA Premises, Mysuru

itemList.description:
Providing, fabricating, supplying, transporting, installing, testing, and commissioning one complete kiosk unit as per approved drawings and design, including all materials, labour, machinery, tools, consumables, accessories, fittings, and finishes required for a fully functional kiosk.
The scope shall include, but is not be limited to:
a)Mild Steel (MS) structural framework fabricated from square/rectangular hollow sections with cutting, welding, grinding, reinforcement, epoxy metal primer, and PU paint finish.
b)Complete FRP/Fiberglass decorative work including moulding, shaping, resin application, reinforcement, putty, sanding, primer, PU paint, and seamless finishing.
c)Marine Grade BWP plywood work for all internal and external paneling, partitions, cabinet carcasses, storage units, shelving, and support members.
d)Complete counter fabrication with MS support, marine plywood structure, finished countertop, cable management, and storage compartments.
e)Front rolling shutter/front door assembly complete with guide channels, locking arrangement, handles, and all accessories.
f)Rear access door complete with frame, hinges, lockset, handles, tower bolt, door closer, and necessary hardware.
g)Complete cabinetry including drawers, shutters, shelves, soft-close hinges, telescopic channels, locks, handles, adjustable shelves, and storage accessories.
h)3D acrylic signage including CNC/laser-cut acrylic letters, logo, LED illumination, drivers, concealed wiring, fixing arrangements, and installation.
i)PU paint and premium surface finishing including putty, sanding, primer, base coat, final PU finish, and clear coat where required on all exposed surfaces.
j)Decorative epoxy resin work including resin casting, logo embedding, protective coating, polishing, and finishing where specified.
k)Supply and installation of all hardware including SS hinges, locks, handles, drawer channels, magnetic catches, gas stays, shelf supports, fasteners, anchor bolts, brackets, screws, and miscellaneous fittings.
l)Complete electrical works including FRLS copper wiring, PVC conduits, modular switches, sockets, LED strip lights, LED spotlights, LED downlights, distribution board (DB), MCBs, RCCB/ELCB, drivers, power outlets, cable management, earthing, testing, and commissioning.
m)All consumables including welding electrodes, MIG wire, cutting discs, grinding wheels, adhesives, silicone sealants, PU sealants, epoxy adhesives, wood glue, edge-band adhesive, masking tape, thinner, cleaning chemicals, primers, putty, fasteners, and all miscellaneous materials necessary for complete execution.
Transportation, loading, unloading, site handling, installation, alignment, anchoring, testing, commissioning, cleaning, and final handover.
n)Wash Basin and Plumbing works etc.,
All necessary design coordination, shop drawings, fabrication drawings, site measurements, quality checks, rectification of defects, and completion of the kiosk ready for operation.
The rate shall include all materials, labour, fabrication, finishing, electrical works, Plumbing,hardware, transportation, installation, testing, commissioning, wastage, overheads, contractor's profit, and all incidental works required to deliver one fully completed kiosk ready for use. No separate payment shall be made for individual components, consumables, accessories, or minor fittings required for successful completion of the work.Strawberry fruit stall of size 10ft (length) x 10ft(Width)x 11ft to 12ft ( Height)approximately.
